transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Well, what brings me in is... I just keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn’t wake up. It's been on my mind a lot. And lately, I’ve just been saying out loud that I really don’t need to see another winter.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this low or hopeless before in your life?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I'm 80 years old, so I've had my share of hard days over the years, but... nothing like this. I've never felt this completely empty before. It's just... no, this is the first time it's been this bad.
Have you been seeing or hearing things that others do not, or have you had any thoughts that feel unusually intense or perhaps not based in reality?

Well... yes, I suppose I have. Some evenings, I hear his voice plain as day. It usually comes from the hallway or the spare room. He keeps telling me that I should have been there, or... that I failed him. It sounds so real to me, but when I mention it, my wife says the house is completely quiet. So I guess I am hearing things she doesn't.
When you hear this voice, do you believe that it is actually someone present in the house, or do you understand that it is something only you are hearing?

Well, I understand that she doesn't hear it, and... I know it sounds foolish to everyone else. But to me, it is real. I’m certain I’m being punished for letting my bowling partner down. My wife and my pastor keep telling me otherwise, trying to convince me it's just in my head, but... no amount of them talking can shake it. I just know I'm being punished.
